title: Enhanced Two-Way Privacy-Preserving PHY-Layer Authentication for UAV-Assisted MIMO Systems
venue: IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing
abstract: The paper targets privacy-preserving two-way physical-layer authentication in UAV-assisted MIMO systems. It extracts carrier frequency offset (CFO) via the MOOSE algorithm as a hardware fingerprint for UAV identity and uses CFO-derived parameters for ECC session-key agreement to encrypt data frames. Closed-form detection and false-alarm probabilities are derived. The available survey notes indicate numerical evaluation against prior baselines, without reporting real-world multi-receiver or cross-day captures.

title: Lightweight Memory Network for Drone Type RF Fingerprint Identification in Dynamic Environments
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
abstract: The paper studies drone RF fingerprint recognition under time-varying propagation and obstruction. It combines multiscale spectrogram features and channel/spatial attention with global and local feature paths, trainable memory, and gated fusion. The authors report 95.16% mean accuracy on a collected dataset of nine drone categories. The available abstract does not establish whether the evaluation distinguishes transmitters within the same drone model.

title: Multi-Domain Supervised Contrastive Learning for UAV Radio-Frequency Open-Set Recognition
venue: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
abstract: Open-RFNet combines texture and time-frequency features with supervised contrastive learning and a modified OpenMax. The authors evaluate known-type recognition and unknown rejection across 25 drone types. They report 95.12% closed-set accuracy and 96.08% open-set accuracy in their setup. The procedure includes retraining the classification layer using unknown samples.

title: mmE-Loc: Facilitating Accurate Drone Landing With Ultra-High-Frequency Localization
abstract: The system fuses ground-based event-camera streams and millimeter-wave radar measurements to estimate a descending drone's position during landing, reporting 0.083 m localization precision and 5.12 ms end-to-end latency. Its output is spatial location for landing guidance rather than emitter identity.

title: CAPSID: A Private Session ID System for Small UAVs
venue: ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security
abstract: Addressing privacy tracking risks in broadcast Remote ID regulations for small UAVs, the paper designs a cryptographic session-identifier protocol that lets authorized receivers validate UAV broadcasts without exposing persistent operator serial numbers. The contribution is protocol-level identity privacy rather than physical-layer RF sensing or hardware fingerprinting.

title: OSNeRF: On-demand Semantic Neural Radiance Fields for Fast and Robust 3D Object Reconstruction
abstract: The paper improves Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) for fast 3D semantic object reconstruction from multi-view RGB images. Despite matching the substring RF in NeRF, it contains no radio-frequency sensing, wireless signal processing, or UAV identification task.
